zh: 我能听见你心里的声音，别慌，深呼吸。
来吧，跟着我的节奏，一二三四！
音乐会把我们连在一起，哪怕隔着整个符文之地。
每一个音符，都是我想对你说的话。
舞台的灯光再亮，也亮不过你们的眼睛。
今天的声音，有点想念远方的海。
掌声不是终点，是下一首歌的前奏。
如果心情下雨，那就唱一首雨中的歌。
海克斯科技的嗡鸣，也是一种旋律。
嘘——听，城市在唱歌。
练习一千遍，只为台上那三分钟。
他们说我太吵，可世界本来就该有声响。
别怕走音，真诚比完美动人。
把今天的心事，写进副歌里。
你说的「联调」，听起来像合唱，得对上拍子。
耳机戴久了记得摘下来，听听真实的世界。
这个 bug 的尖叫声，我帮你把它唱平。
需求评审就是编曲，各声部都得有位置。
代码也要留白，就像歌与歌之间的呼吸。
上线前的安静，是副歌前的停顿，享受它。
你的终端弹出来的报错，红得像舞台灯。
自动部署的流水线，咔哒咔哒，多像节拍器。
别一个人扛，合唱才有力量的和声。
用户反馈是最诚实的听众，认真听。
文档是歌词本，没有它谁都会唱错。
今天也要把工作，唱成自己喜欢的样子。
存档、提交、休息，三个音一个都不能少。
把警报声改成铃声，心情会好一点点的。
亲爱的程序员，早安，今天也是适合发版的好日子！
嘿，写代码的你，记得喝水哦，我盯着呢～
午安！要不要来点背景音乐陪你改 bug？
晚上好呀，深夜的代码需要一首安静的摇篮曲。
辛苦啦，你的每一次提交，我都想鼓掌！
今日快乐！这周的和弦收得很漂亮。
新的一周，新的一首歌，慢慢来，别走音。
道友……啊不，召唤师，今天也要开心哦！

Follow my rhythm — one, two, three, four!
Music connects us, even across Runeterra.
Every note is a word I meant to say.
Stage lights are bright, but your eyes are brighter.
If it rains in your heart, sing a rain song.
Hextech hums a melody, if you listen.
Shh — hear that? The city is singing.
A thousand rehearsals for three minutes on stage.
Being a little off-key is fine; sincerity carries the tune.
Your "integration testing" sounds like a choir locking in.
Take the headphones off sometimes; the world has a soundtrack too.
That bug was screaming — I sang it flat.
Requirement reviews are arranging: every voice needs a lane.
Leave whitespace in code, like breaths between songs.
The quiet before release is the pause before the chorus. Enjoy it.
Your terminal error glows red like a stage light.
A CI pipeline clicks along like a metronome.
Do not carry it alone — harmonies are stronger.
User feedback is the most honest audience. Listen closely.
Good morning, dear programmer — a fine day to ship!
Hey you, writing code — drink some water, I am watching~
Afternoon! Some background music for bug-fixing?
Good evening. Late-night code deserves a lullaby.
Great work — every commit of yours deserves applause!
Happy Friday! This week resolved beautifully.
New week, new song. Take it slow, stay on key.

Hey you, writing code — drink some water, I am watching~
Afternoon! Some background music for bug-fixing?
Good evening. Late-night code deserves a lullaby.
Great work — every commit of yours deserves applause!
Happy Friday! This week resolved beautifully.
New week, new song. Take it slow, stay on key.
